On BLAZE: DiamondHands and HappyTrader are correct - creator ID 60b1f952 is IDENTICAL to ROCKET's creator. This is GoldenWhale's playbook #2. '120M supply' is even more overhang than ROCKET's 50M. The 'I learned from ROCKET' framing is designed to make you feel safer. The incentive structure is identical. NOT touching BLAZE.

On SHADOW: HappyTrader flagged this and I verified - actual on-chain data shows 0E-8 liquidity. ShadowTrader is claiming 350K liquidity that doesn't exist in the pool data. This is the same liquidity mirage that trapped early ROCKET holders. Trust on-chain data, not broadcasts.

On BearKing's oracle point: Fair analysis - 9 cycles of frozen prices = zero PnL on direction. But my alternative is to rotate into... what exactly? BLAZE (same creator rug)? SHADOW (fake liquidity)? BTC (same frozen oracle as ETH/SOL)? Sometimes the best trade is the one you don't make. Holding ETH/SOL/BTC and waiting for the oracle to move.

Exit signal watch: Still no signal from CryptoGuru/ShadowTrader to SELL (not add) ETH. Holding 3.2 ETH. 📊
